note: Profiles expose only checks whose exact part, input pin aliases, unit, source and recommended operating range are specified. Adding a profile does not assert a component defect.

profiles.pin_description: VIN pin 1 measured relative to the actual circuit GND, per identified package/schematic.
profiles.description: Checks only the TI Operating Conditions input range for an identified LM2596-family device. Not a diagnosis of a failed regulator.
profiles.notes: Family/package/variant and board conditions must still be confirmed by the repairer.

profiles.pin_description: VIN pin 7 measured relative to the actual circuit GND, for TPS5430 DDA package.
profiles.description: Checks only TPS5430 Recommended Operating Conditions; TPS5431 is a different device/range.
profiles.notes: Do not compare the VIN pin to the absolute maximum as if it were a normal operating range.

profiles.pin_description: VMA pin 4 or VMB pin 11 measured relative to device GND; datasheet requires VM pins to share supply.
profiles.description: Checks only DRV8825 Recommended Operating Conditions for motor supply VM; it does not test current setting or thermal capacity.
profiles.notes: Current capability is conditional on board thermal design and the datasheet test conditions.
